fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-06-11 (afternoon, 12:55): The complainant paid Rs. 1,50,000 for a maroon motorcycle bearing registration number TN-45-XX-1060 sold as second-hand, but the ownership transfer was not completed and the seller became unreachable. The complainant alleged that Hariharan Prakash may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000017. A witness, Dinesh Subramani, reachable on 9000000212, was mentioned in the complaint. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00266, as the mobile number 9000000017 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Seller reportedly shared doubtful papers and stopped responding.
fields.Keywords: vehicle sale, cheating, suspect, mobile number, motorcycle, witness statement, afternoon, documents
